description: Vbee's Vietnamese TTS API with an async batch mode for long text and a sync realtime mode that streams audio chunks (~500 ms to first chunk).

meta.legacy_api: Text to Speech (Lagacy) endpoints still documented
meta.modes: mode=async (batch, webhookUrl, ≤100,000 chars, mp3/wav); mode=sync (realtime chunked audio, ≤300 chars, mp3/wav/pcm, limited to 5 voices)
meta.pricing_note: API is quote-based (contact sales); vbee.vn/pricing lists Studio plans only
meta.voice_list_api: GET https://vbee.vn/api/public/v1/voices (also lists voices for ~50 non-Vietnamese locales; their origin is not stated)

name: Vbee Text to Speech API
